name: automotion-comic-studio-frontend
description: AutoMotion Comic Studio Desktop Frontend (Electron + React + TypeScript + PixiJS + Zustand)

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron .
